reason: No register belief covers trace-link deciders, so it decides the priority 3 linking design rather than a grade: LinkRank's metadata ranker beat LLM agents on issue-to-commit links (F1 73.17 against 48.39), and the spec tests whether ranking candidate PRs by cheap features and asking Jev about only the top 5 loses no more than 3 F1 points against asking about every candidate. Now, because the answer sets how many model calls keeping the graph current will cost, and it supplies the candidate sets to which E-20260928-08-r2's choice of decider applies.
